hardness_axes.reasoning: The public symptoms do not identify unsafe structural-symmetry grouping, uncleared probe-seed reuse on plan resume, cross-batch step-magnitude retention, or sparse-orientation mismatch at unpack. The solver must recover those facts from C, Rust, Fortran, and metamorphic runs.

hardness_axes.name: Synthesize
hardness_axes.reasoning: Correct packed sensitivity requires coordinated behavior across a C partitioner, a Rust plan/seed boundary, a Rust magnitude authority, and a Fortran unpack/reindex stage. No module contains the complete scientific invariant.

hardness_axes.name: Diagnose
hardness_axes.reasoning: The instruction reports incompatible packed entries, directional products, support mismatches, and summary disagreement without naming coloring, CPR, seed vectors, finite-difference step policy, CSR/CSC orientation, or fix sites.

hardness_axes.name: Navigate coupling
hardness_axes.reasoning: A corrected partition still fails if seeds leak across resume, correct seeds still fail under stale magnitude, and correct upstream compression still serializes differently when the Fortran unpack orientation disagrees.

hardness_axes.name: Reason beyond training
hardness_axes.reasoning: A textbook CPR coloring routine can address only the partition shape. The custom plan lifecycle, magnitude scoping, and Fortran sparse-orientation contract create a project-specific scientific coupling that cannot be solved by copying one reference implementation.

discovery_budget.discovery: The column partitioner treats a structurally symmetric nonzero pattern as a safe grouping even when the residual Jacobian is numerically unsymmetric, so structurally non-orthogonal unknowns share a probe.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming structural symmetry, coloring, or orthogonality would collapse the C diagnosis into a textbook CPR lookup.

discovery_budget.discovery: Resuming a saved probe plan rebinds group slots without clearing prior seed bits, so later groups inherit leaked contributions from earlier partitions.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming seed hygiene or plan-slot clearing would directly expose the Rust plan-boundary repair.

discovery_budget.discovery: Absolute finite-difference step magnitude is derived from a residual norm cached when the first plan is built and reused after independent scale-equivalent batches arrive.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Stating that step policy must reset per batch would directly expose the magnitude lifecycle repair.

discovery_budget.discovery: Compression packs nonzero contributions using one sparse orientation while the Fortran unpack reads the opposite orientation, scrambling retained entries after otherwise correct probes.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming CSR/CSC or row/column major unpack would reduce the Fortran work to a disclosed layout flip.

instruction_specificity.reasoning: The public draft describes incompatible packed sensitivity reports and directional products across equivalent batches without naming algorithms, thresholds, schemas, or causes.

attack_path.summary: Reproduce permutation and resume divergence, isolate which packed entries and directional products disagree, trace plan/seed and magnitude lifecycle, then reconcile sparse unpack orientation across the Fortran boundary.
attack_path.reasoning: The path requires experiments and cross-language model building; no prompt noun, file name, or single failed assertion reveals all four locations.

smallest_plausible_patch.summary: Coordinated substantive edits to one C partition kernel, two Rust plan/magnitude locations, and one Fortran unpack fold, together exceeding a trivial patch.
smallest_plausible_patch.reasoning: Any strict subset leaves at least one permutation, resume, scale, support, directional-product, or deterministic-report property failing.

collapse_audit.reasoning: The editable frontier spans four non-obvious locations across three languages, the instruction remains symptoms-only, no declarative cluster or reference output exists, and the planned oracle adds substantive logic rather than deleting or toggling one feature.
collapse_audit.residual_hardness: After the complete file tree is visible, the solver must still identify why mathematically equivalent residual batches cross different partition and representation authorities and then preserve one invariant through four locations.

topology_enumeration.summary: Partition orthogonality, plan/seed lifecycle, magnitude scoping, and unpack orientation disagree across the C, Rust, and Fortran pipeline.
topology_enumeration.why_no_single_location_suffices: A correct partition can still be poisoned by leaked seeds or stale magnitude, and correct upstream probes can still unpack into a different packed matrix.

topology_enumeration.summary: Pattern build, seed application, compressed difference, and foreign status mapping form a four-stage probe chain.
topology_enumeration.why_no_single_location_suffices: Correct groups are useless if seeds are wrong, correct seeds are useless if compression packs incorrectly, and correct compressed vectors are useless if the host rebinds the wrong plan slots.

topology_enumeration.summary: Residual local coordinates, global unknown indexing, color-group membership, and Fortran unpack use incompatible index conventions.
topology_enumeration.why_no_single_location_suffices: Changing one convention only moves the disagreement to another boundary; producers and consumers must represent the same unknown-to-entry map.
